change: Added a Local AI provider that talks directly to your own OpenAI-compatible server (e.g. LM Studio), with a model picker fetched live from it, for chat and screenshot interpretation that never leaves your network. The free plan's monthly limit no longer blocks or counts against chat, the floating bar, quick chat, or screenshot interpretation while Local is active, since none of them touch Omi's cloud model. Closed the remaining gaps: the chat-quota banner above the composer no longer shows a cloud usage warning while Local is active, and a quota error from a memories/conversations tool call mid-turn now degrades to a tool-result error instead of ever being able to block the turn. Voice transcription is unaffected by the chat provider and always goes through Omi's Deepgram proxy
